ACT XIII OF 2012
ACT XIII OF 2012
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA UNIVERSITIES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012
An Act to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Universities Act, 2012
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa,
Extraordinary,
20th September, 2012]
No. PA/
Khyber Pakhutnkhwa/ Bills/
2012/ 6071, dated 20-9-2012.-The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities (Amendment) Bill, 2012 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khybver Pakhtunkhwa on 10th September, 2012 and assented to by the
Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 17th September,
2012 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Universities Act, 2012 (Khytber Pakhtunkhwa
Act No.X of 2012), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Universities (Amendment) Act, 2012.
It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 3 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No.X of 2012

Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 17th September,
2012 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Universities Act, 2012 (Khytber Pakhtunkhwa
Act No.X of 2012), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:
2. Amendment
of section 3 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No.X of 2012.-In the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Universities Act, 2012 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No.X of 2012), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in
section 3, in subsection (2), the full stop at the end shall be replaced by
colon and thereafter the following
proviso shall be added, namely:
"Provided
that the Government may set up a University in place of compus
or sub-compus of any University listed in the
Schedule and transfer all assets, liabilities, employees and students of such compus or sub-campus to such University."

in the Schedule to the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No.X of 2012.-In the said Act in the Schedule,--
(i) against serial No.2, the words
"Khyber Pakhtunkhwa" shall be deleted;
(ii)
against serial No.3,
for the existing entry, the following shall be substituted, namely:
"The University of Agriculture,
Peshawar."; and
(iii)

the Khushal Khan
